result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. It compiles, and `mvn -o -pl reports test -Dtest='DataExporter*'` ran with no output (`-q` hides passing results). I didn't run a renamed-aspect export, and I didn't check that the matched tests exercise this method.

The change is in `aspectFileLists` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It now builds each file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that names the loose `data/text/aspect_<name>.txt` files. The five entries keep their order: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. I also updated the Javadoc to say the names are derived.

With the default configuration the entries are the same five names as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written when `git-history.txt` exists.
